The *Aññabhāgiya* rule, designated as Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Saṅghādisesa 9 (*Bu-Vb Ss9*), belongs to the Vinaya Piṭaka's Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga. The disciplinary rule establishes that a Buddhist monk who, driven by anger, uses an indirect pretext or ploy to falsely accuse a fellow monk of an offense entailing expulsion (*pārājika*) commits a grave infraction requiring formal suspension and rehabilitation by the Saṅgha (*saṅghādisesa*). The text is available in an English translation by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
